mapper.update: UPDATE post_comment SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.content, c.author_no AS authorNo, e.name AS authorName, e.position AS position, c.posted_at AS postedAt FROM post_comment c JOIN employee e ON c.author_no = e.employee_no WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.posted_at ASC
